ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Provider Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent $3 million in fraud charges against a Medicaid provider in Minnesota. It would explore the details of the case, the impact on the Medicaid program, and potential implications for other providers.
questions: What are the details of the fraud charges?
How will this impact the Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the ongoing issue of Medicaid fraud and the need for continued investigation and oversight.

ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Cuts on Mental Health and Substance Abuse Programs
ideas.description: This story would explore the potential impact of federal funding cuts on mental health and substance abuse programs. It would examine the effects on communities, alternative solutions, and the debate around funding.
questions: What are the potential effects of funding cuts?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the ongoing debate around funding for mental health and substance abuse programs and the potential impact on communities.
